subject.title: chore(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 5 updates

question: Do the local-auth and Vercel failures reproduce on current main, or must this grouped dependency update be split before merge?
rationale: Automated checks establish broad compile and test health but do not determine whether the remaining runtime failures are baseline instability or a regression introduced by one of five production updates.

options.title: Compare and rerun
options.body: Rebase if needed, compare the failing checks against current main, and merge the group only if the failures are demonstrably unrelated.

options.title: Split the dependency group
options.body: Close or replace this grouped PR with isolated updates if any failed runtime path is unique to the branch or cannot be confidently attributed.

options.title: Accept known instability
options.body: Merge the group while explicitly owning the unresolved browser and preview risk if maintainers already recognize these failures as non-blocking infrastructure noise.

recommendation.title: Compare and rerun
recommendation.body: Rebase if needed, compare the failing checks against current main, and merge the group only if the failures are demonstrably unrelated.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release, CI, and publishing integration work makes this the best available owner for deciding whether the remaining failures are acceptable.
